summary: Iteration 49: Codice fiscale required for Italian clienti/fornitori (API + PartyDialog + Excel import preview), live layout preview in Impostazioni, piede_ddt + DDT PDF. New test file has 17/17 passing. Regression tests for iterations 44/46/47/48 have 57/57 passing. UI flows checked on desktop and mobile all pass. Found 3 minor issues, none blocking.

minor.issue: A row with nazione IT and no CF is correctly flagged, but the message reads 'riga: Il codice fiscale è obbligatorio...' instead of 'codice_fiscale: ...'. _verr (importazione.py:75) uses e.errors()[0]['loc'], which is empty for model_validator errors, so the FieldError.field is lost and it falls back to 'riga'.

Existed before this change: PartyIn._piva requires 11 digits even when nazione != IT, so a foreign VAT number like DE123456789 or FR12345678901 gets a 422 'La Partita IVA deve avere 11 cifre'. Foreign parties can only be saved with an Italian-format VAT number or none. CF is now optional for foreign parties, so this check should probably depend on nazione too.
The Clienti/Fornitori header 'codice_fiscale' has no marker or note that it is required for nazione IT (the import model's Istruzioni sheet could mention it).

ui_bugs.issue: The company address line in the preview shows only the comune ('Roma'), without indirizzo or CAP. LayoutPreview reads useCompany().company, which comes from GET /api/companies. That projection (server.py:788) only returns id, denominazione, partita_iva, comune, moduli, periodicita_iva and menu_off, so indirizzo and cap are undefined.

issues: The 'Nota di credito' preview tab wraps onto 2 lines next to the 'ANTEPRIMA DAL VIVO' label, which also wraps (cosmetic).

passed_tests: POST /api/parties cliente+fornitore with nazione IT/it/'' and CF ''/'   ' -> 422 with loc codice_fiscale and the Italian message
POST with CF -> 200; PUT removing CF -> 422; PUT with CF persists (checked with GET); PUT switching to FR without CF -> 200
Import preview: Clienti rows with IT and with empty nazione and no CF are flagged; Fornitori row with IT and no CF is flagged; rows with CF and foreign rows without CF pass

PUT /api/company/layout piede_ddt persists; max length 2000 enforced (422); DDT PDF has the piede_ddt text and the logo image, does not include piede_fattura, and has no image once the logo is removed

PartyDialog (Clienti + Fornitori tabs): label 'CODICE FISCALE *' for IT and 'CODICE FISCALE' for DE; saving IT without CF shows field-error-codice-fiscale, a red border rgb(225,29,72) and a toast, and the dialog stays open; foreign party saves and appears in the list

Layout preview: placed to the right of the form on desktop (x=1255 vs form) and below it on mobile; changing the colour updates layout-preview-numero live; uploading a logo shows layout-preview-logo; switching off cliente_pec/causale hides those lines; extra phone shown live; tabs fattura/nc/ddt switch layout-preview-piede between piede_fattura/piede_nc/piede_ddt; DDT tab hides totale/IBAN; save + reload keeps piede_ddt, colore and logo
action_items: (Low) importazione._verr: for errors with an empty loc, use FieldError.field (e.errors()[0].get('ctx', {}).get('error')) so the message says 'codice_fiscale: ...' instead of 'riga: ...'
(Low) Consider allowing foreign VAT formats in PartyIn._piva when nazione != IT (this check existed before this change)
(Low) LayoutPreview: show indirizzo/cap, e.g. by adding indirizzo and cap to the /api/companies projection or by fetching /api/company
(Cosmetic) Mention in the import model's Istruzioni sheet that codice_fiscale is required for nazione IT
critical_code_review_comments: The CF rule has no format check: any non-empty string such as 'x' is accepted for IT parties. Consider at least checking the length (16 alphanumeric characters or 11 digits).

Italian parties that already exist in the DB without a CF can no longer be saved until a CF is added. This is expected, but users could be told about it (for example by flagging those parties in the Anagrafiche list).
_supplier (passive invoice import) inserts parties directly and bypasses PartyIn. This is acceptable, but such fornitori may have no CF and will then fail on their next edit.
